therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: HDAC inhibition leading to chromatin remodeling and gene re-expression
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: restoration of sodium-iodide symporter expression and radioiodine sensitivity
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with advanced thyroid cancers of follicular cell origin
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: radioactive iodine uptake and thyroglobulin level changes

results.effect_size: 0/13 patients achieved complete response, 10/13 had no RAI uptake post-treatment
results.target_engagement_evidence: NIS expression increased from 21% to 25% (median relative to GAPDH)
biomarker_changes: NIS mRNA expression increased from 21% to 25% relative to GAPDH
Thyroglobulin levels varied widely with most patients showing persistent elevation
subgroup_findings: 6/7 patients in Phase 2 had progressive disease
1/7 patients in Phase 2 had stable disease

dose_info.schedule: escalating from 500 mg daily to 500 mg morning + 1000 mg evening

context.indication: advanced thyroid cancers of follicular cell origin
